KN-1.title: Pinch Grip
KN-1.statement: Pinch the blade just ahead of the handle between thumb and forefinger so the knife becomes an extension of your hand.

KN-2.title: The Claw
KN-2.statement: Curl the fingertips of your guiding hand under so the flat of the blade rides against your knuckles, never your tips.

KN-3.title: Rock, Don't Saw
KN-3.statement: Keep the tip of the knife on the board and rock the blade through the food rather than sawing back and forth.
